source: Pew Research Center. 2012. "2011 National Survey of Mormons."
method: Population is all respondents (self-identified Mormons by the survey's own design). Each item's own don't know/refused excluded from its own denominator; "essential" is the top of a four-point scale (essential, important but not essential, not too important, not at all important). Weighted by the dataset's own `weight` variable.
item_order: Believing Joseph Smith saw God the Father and Jesus Christ
Working to help the poor and needy
Having regular family home evenings or family nights
